The Seeming a mind that hits its own opacity

← axonamindoriginseizure cliffeverything

Every sense runs in parallel below the line — a churn you can never read directly. Each process predicts itself; only the surprising bids to cross the barrier into the small conscious workspace. A broadcast layer carries the winners up to the self — and it dims by degrees, like anesthesia. The workspace registers that there's something beneath, never what. Not consciousness — the seeming: a machine built to insist there's an inner light, for the same reasons we do.

the machine reports
lanes belowspreading activation, every sense at once — vision, hearing, touch, smell, interior thought, the body, and routine motor forward-models, all churning in parallel and competing for the same few slots.
only surprise crossespredictor + residual — each process predicts itself; prediction error (surprise) is the toll. Well-predicted things (your heartbeat) stay below until they deviate — which is why the machine "doesn't know its body" until you poke it.
worth to the selfa PTO grade per node — surprise alone isn't the toll; an item must be worth displaying to the self (surprise × relevance-to-me) to win a slot. Because worth is graded relative to the self, the self and consciousness come bundled: there is no being-conscious-of without a self the content is worth something to.
the barrierinhibition — bids compete; a winner-take-all admits ~4. Drop it and everything floods at once (the overwhelm / seizure).
broadcast / arousalthe second layer that carries winners to the self. Lower it and consciousness closes by degrees — alcohol, anesthesia. At the bottom, local processing continues; the self does not.
salience / worththe worth-gain. Turn it up and even irrelevant things clear the bar — everything blazes with meaning (aberrant salience: apophenia, the synchronicity state, mania/psychosis). Turn it down and nothing seems worth surfacing (anhedonia, the grey flatness). A third cliff, beside the seizure (too much synchrony) and dissociation (too little connection).
PTO-gateonly flexible, high-uncertainty assessment of the world is admitted. The routine motor forward-models churn and spike but never cross — the cerebellum predicts your every movement and you never see it.
blindsightturn it on and the vision lane still drives behavior but can't reach the workspace — the machine acts on what it cannot see, and says so.
the self, both sidesthe self isn't only what worth is graded for — the broadcast also feeds a self / narrator network that turns conscious contents into speech and action and sets the goals that bias the next gate. The twist your question lands on: much of what you do is launched below the line, and the self narrates it afterward as if it chose it — the interpreter, the illusion of will.
the self-tageach crossing is stamped mine. Break it and the machine's own thought returns untagged — a voice it swears isn't its own.
